definition: תְּרַע noun [masculine] gate, door ( ᵑ7 Syriac; Biblical Hebrew שַׁ֫עַר , √I. שׁער ); — construct ׳ ת : 1. door of furnace Dan 3:26 . 2. gate of king, i.e. palace, court, Dan 2:29 (compare Esth 2:19 , see שַׁ֫עַר 3 a ; also Arabic gate , then the court of a sovereign; plural Sublime Porte , of Turkish court, see especially Dozy i. 124 ).

BDB10019 | BIBLICAL ARAMAIC | BDB10021

תְּרַע noun [masculine] gate, door (ᵑ7 Syriac; Biblical Hebrew שַׁ֫עַר, √I. שׁער); — construct ׳ת:

1. door of furnace Dan 3:26.
2. gate of king, i.e. palace, court, Dan 2:29 (compare Esth 2:19, see שַׁ֫עַר 3 a; also Arabic gate, then the court of a sovereign; plural Sublime Porte, of Turkish court, see especially Dozyi. 124).
